title: RAKU FIRING!
source_quote: RAKU FIRING! Saturday, May 16, 2026 9:00 AM 1:00 PM Join us for a very special visiting artist workshop, our first ever RAKU firing with Herrick Smith!
evidence_sentence: The workshop page lists a raku firing with visiting artist Herrick Smith on May 16, 2026.
evidence_quote: Join us for a very special visiting artist workshop, our first ever RAKU firing with Herrick Smith!
summary: This raku firing with visiting artist Herrick Smith ran on May 16, 2026 (a past date). Participants brought one small pre-fired ceramic item and glazes were provided and applied on site. The workshop included a historical overview of raku.
bring: one small pre-fired ceramic item (bisque), about the size of a coffee cup
